title: Payment-Record Bonus Bands for Rental Sale Cancellations
content:
Six or more premium payments posted in the six months before the confirmation earn a Rental Property Service Contracts sale cancellation credit a payment-record bonus of 0.03; three to five earn 0.01.

| Premium payments posted on the contract in the 6 months before the confirmation | Bonus |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.03 |
| 3 to 5 | 0.01 |
| fewer than 3 | 0 |

**Records read.** The premium payments in the contract's billing history and their posting dates.

**How the bonus acts.** Every bonus on a sale cancellation credit is added to one in a single sum, and the credit is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

| Payments in the 6 months | Bonus |
|---|---|
| 2 | 0 |
| 3 | 0.01 |
| 5 | 0.01 |
| 6 | 0.03 |
